energy_note: The source names no Energy type: the API decklist for this entry has no 'energy' field and the Limitless page shows no energy section. The file's 'Energy: Lightning' line is the one thing in it the source does not state itself. It was set from the archetype's own declarations in the development half: 54 of the 65 lists declare ['Lightning'] and 11 declare nothing; no list declares Grass or any other type; 29 of the 31 Poncho carriers and 30 of the 34 lists that run Teal Mask Ogerpon ex B2 017 declare Lightning only; and the three entries that run warpis's exact 20 cards (liquidedge, angrypikachu, zagazaga) all declare ['Lightning']. Teal Mask Ogerpon ex's attack costs [GG], which this deck cannot pay; the lists that run it declare Lightning only, so it is in the deck for its Ability (Soothing Wind), not to attack.
printings: Every card uses the exact set/number the Limitless source names; python lib/card.py reports each of the 15 ids as '1 printings, 1 distinct', so no printing choice was needed.
